windowsHint: Windows uses native HERDR. Each WSL distribution has its own client and Sessions.
enableWslHint: Enable to discover and connect WSL hosts. Disabling disconnects Yuzora and preserves running Sessions.
connectFirst: Connect this SSH host before checking its runtime.
hostUnavailable: This host is unavailable. Select a host again.
nativeCurrentHint: The client selected by this Yuzora process.
checkBeforeApply: Check the exact binary and running Sessions before saving. Switching clients does not stop HERDR servers.
savedPathHint: Saved resolved path. Check again to obtain its current status.
remoteApplyHint: The target client and Sessions are checked again before applying. Failed checks preserve the saved configuration.
updateAvailableHint: The saved tools differ from this Yuzora bundle. Check and update the client while preserving existing servers.
managedHint: Use the verified version bundled with this Yuzora release.
installedHint: Detect HERDR on this host. Missing or incompatible versions block applying; another source is never silently substituted.
customLocalHint: Specify an absolute HERDR executable path on this computer.
customRemoteHint: Specify an absolute Linux/macOS path inside the selected host. Do not use a Windows path for WSL.
preserveSessions: Choose a client compatible with the existing server. If a server change is needed, save work and review the affected Sessions above first. Yuzora will not stop them automatically.
